text: Manoeuvring. About the Initiative
zh: 调动与主动权

text: In chess works and commentaries we quite often come across the term 'manoeuvering". Following the example of the late grandmaster Tartakover, it is sometimes substituted for the concept of "tacking", though in the semantic sense both terms are not the same.
zh: 在国际象棋著作与评注中，我们经常遇到“调动”一词。按照已故特级大师塔塔科维的用法，有时人们会用它替代“迂回”这一概念，尽管从语义上说，两者并不相同。

text: Manoeuvering is a term coming from the German word manöver, which means manoeuvre.
zh: “调动”一词源自德语manöver，意为“运子”。

text: However, one should not mix up the concepts of 'manoeuvre' and 'manoeuvering'. A manoeuvre is several moves of one piece, usually made with some concrete aim. Manoeuvering is a series of manoeuvres with different pieces, bearing a more or less prolonged character and rarely having a clearly outlined aim.
zh: 不过，不应混淆“运子”和“调动”两个概念。运子，是同一枚棋子连续走数步，通常带有某种具体目标；调动，则是不同棋子一系列运子的组合，持续时间较长，而且很少具有清晰明确的目标。

text: Manoeuvering is a concept that arose in connection with a definite phenomenon on the horizons of chess art which appeared at the end of the last century and was provoked mainly by the advocating of dogmatism by a number of representatives of the English and German chess schools.
zh: 调动是一个与上世纪末出现在国际象棋艺术视野中的特定现象有关的概念，主要是由英国和德国国际象棋流派的一些代表提倡教条主义引起的。

text: In a number of events, with these masters came to be recommended a form of waiting tactics. One of the partners, following this recommendation, waited until his opponent finally created a real weakness in his camp or made some other sort of mistake. It would also happen that both partners, having learned to be patient, began to manoeuvre by themselves in the rear of communications, following a policy of extreme caution and trying not to give each other even if only the slightest chance of attack.
zh: 在许多事件中，这些大师开始推荐一种等待策略。其中一位合伙人按照这一建议，等到他的对手最终在他的阵营中制造了一个真正的弱点或犯了一些其他类型的错误。也有可能，双方都学会了耐心，开始运子独自站在通讯后方，遵循极其谨慎的政策，尽量不给对方哪怕是最轻微的攻击机会。

text: This, of course, did not mean that all manoeuvering merited censure.
zh: 当然，这并不意味着所有调动都应该受到谴责。

text: In manoeuvering one can perceive several gradations. Besides waiting, aimless manoeuvring, there is also forcing, planning manoeuvring. This takes place in those cases where the achievement of the intended aim requires prolonged piece and pawn manoeuvres. This aspect of manoeuvering is seen particularly often in positions of a closed t type, that is with mutually locked pawn chains.
zh: 在调动中，人们可以感知到几个层次。除了等待、漫无目的调动，还有强迫、计划调动。当实现预期目标需要延长棋子和兵运子时，就会发生这种情况。调动的这个方面特别常见于闭合 t 类型的位置，即具有相互锁定的兵链。

text: We also begin our review with positions of this sort - and playing them is difficult and requires a profound and penetrating assessment of positions from the chessplayer.
zh: 我们也从这类棋局开始我们的审查——下棋很困难，需要棋手对棋局进行深刻而深入的评估。

text: The Black king's position is seriously weakened, the f6, f7 and h7 pawns could become objects of attack. However, for this it is necessary to radically change the conditions of the struggle on the king's flank. The fact of the matter is that Black's weaknesses are for the present reliably defended, it is not easy to take control of the g and e-files; the position of the
zh: 黑方王的地位被严重削弱，f6、f7和h7兵可能成为攻击对象。然而，为此有必要从根本上改变王翼上的斗争条件。事实上，黑方的弱点目前已被可靠防守，控制g和e线并不容易；的位置

text: White king is also far from being perfect, and, if White, in the course of his attack, has to push the pawns on the king's flank, then all the pre-requisites are there for a counter-attack by the opponent.
zh: 白王也远非完美，如果白在进攻过程中必须将王翼上的兵推下去，那么对手反击的先决条件就具备了。

text: In short, the advantage is on White's side, but to convert it into something real proves to be a complicated and difficult task. In fact, from the further course of the game it is seen that the plan contemplated by Alekhine represents a 40 move process of manoeuvering, in the course of which only one pawn exchange will be made. It is interesting that, in the final manoeuvering, White announces mate in six moves, with the same pieces present as when the process began.
zh: 简而言之，优势在白方这边，但要将其转化为现实，却是一项复杂而艰巨的任务。事实上，从对局的进一步进程可以看出，阿廖欣所设想的方案代表了调动的40步过程，在此过程中只会进行一次兵交换。有趣的是，在最后的调动中，白方宣布六步杀，并与过程开始时相同的棋子出现。

text: White's plan consists of: (1) the transfer of the king to a safe place on the queen's flank; (2) the storming advance of the g-pawn; and (3) piece manoeuvres with the aim of a harmonious concentration of all his forces and a directing of their co-ordinated blows on the f6 and h7 points.
zh: 白方的计划包括：（1）将王转移到后翼上的安全地点；(2) 猛攻冲兵；（3）棋子运子，其目的是和谐地集中所有力量，并指挥他们对f6和h7点进行协调打击。

text: It is perfectly clear that, with full equality of forces for the attacking and defending sides and a pawn chain position which is not locked, the fulfilment of such a manoeuvering plan looks like being an unusually complex matter.
zh: 很显然，在攻守双方兵力完全平等且兵链阵地未锁定的情况下，完成这样一个调动计划看起来是一件异常复杂的事情。

One can surmise that, at the present moment, Yates considered his position to be more than reliable.
zh: 黑方运子，没有任何特定目的。这很容易理解：敌方阵地中没有可以进行进攻的薄弱环节；与此同时，白方的计划仍然不明确，事实上他也仍然无法制造出任何危险的威胁。可以推测，目前，耶茨认为他的立场非常可靠。

text: This is the picture that emerges: White purposefully manoeuvres and according to plan, preparing a decisive attack on the king's flank while Black occupies himself for the time being with waiting manoeuvres. It is clear that creative technique, characterised by concrete ideas and purposefulness, must gain victory over passive waiting tactics.
zh: 出现的画面是这样的：白方有目的地运子并按照计划，准备对王翼进行决定性的攻击，而黑方则暂时等待运子。显然，以具体想法和目的为特征的创造性技术必须战胜被动等待策略。

text: Only after 12 moves is this pawn advanced to its appointed square not until the White king is finally "established" in a safe little nook and his pieces are regrouped to extract as much as possible from the advance g4-g5. All this requires scrupulous, thorough work and, of course, patience.

text: Alekhine was a master of great creative dynamism, but dynamics combine badly with such slow manoeuvring. zh: 以齐果林和阿廖欣的经典国际象棋作品为例，我们能够说服自己，调动可以隐藏深刻的目的和思想。然而，要将调动单调的过程转化为灿烂的思想恩赐，需要将顽强的奋斗精神、创造性的灵感和棋艺融为一体。

text: Despite White's extra pawn in the game Blackburne-Albin from Hastings 1895, he cannot achieve anything - the construction of the position excludes the possibility of a breakthrough. The potential weakness of the Black b6 pawn cannot be realised. There are no open files on the board, and the heavy pieces of both partners are doomed to inactivity. However, having an extra pawn, Blackburne did not want to content himself with a draw. As a result, there arises the process of many moves of manoeuvring, in which White only waits to see if Black will by chance relax his attention to the b6 pawn. Black likewise cannot do anything and is obliged to manoeuvre. The defence of the b6 pawn does not present any particular difficulty. Let us see how events developed.

text: A continuation which gives the game a locked character. The struggle now enters a manoeuvring phase which lasts not more, not less than 30 moves. Throughout this long period, the sides 'succeed" in producing just one pawn exchange. Such a process of manoeuvring requires great patience from the partners. However, an early exchange of queens is not to everyone's taste. But the main thing is this, that White reckons on carrying out, in the near future, the advance d3-d4 or f2-f4, opening the centre, but does not take into account that the opponent will prevent the execution of this plan, after which he has to manoeuvre until the end of the game.

The best testimony to this is the fact that it is impossible now for White to play 15. f4, which, after the exchange on f4, leads to the loss of the central pawn. As a result, White is forced into waiting, though 1also not pointless, manoeuvring. text: And though in the practice of our grandmasters and masters, who present themselves before the whole chess world as players with a fighting, energetic, ， enterprising style, such cases are comparatively we nevertheless give one rare, example of this in the hope that it will not be imitated by the readers of this book.

zh: 对局开始呈现锁定角色 - 将其转移到调动通道的首要先决条件。

text: Very slow, though repeatedly met in practice. 7. Be2 was played in the first game of the Smyslov. Botvinnik return match, but also upon this the game continuation comes to assume the aspect of a manoeuvring struggle without exchanges.

text: The present moment in the game is highly instructive. It shows that the process of manoeuvring is far from always created by chance or comes about by coincidence, without depending on the will of the players. Manoeuvring arises at times also as a result of a conscious striving for it by one or both opponents. From the creative point of view, what is not brought about by such striving cannot justify itself.
zh: 对局中的当前时刻非常有启发性。这表明调动的过程并不总是偶然产生或巧合的，而不取决于玩家的意志。调动有时也会由于一个或两个对手有意识地努力而出现。从创造性的角度来看，没有这种努力所带来的东西是不能自圆其说的。

text: Instead of locking the position and automatically y transferring to manoeuvring, White had at his disposal an active plan of attack in the centre: 11. d4 followed by Be3, Rad1, and f4. Black could hardly accept the pawn sacrifice 11...

text: The chess struggle, which is full of initiative and enterprising play, assumes quite a different character.
zh: 充满主动权和进取心的国际象棋斗争呈现出截然不同的特征。

text: We have already used the term "initiative" time and again in the pages of this book. The Latin word "initium"1 means the principle of initiative. Initiative in life - this is a display of activity in any area of man's work. The initiative is born, becomes apparent and is developed out of a resolute striving for individual or collective thoughts. In the chess struggle the initiative likewise presents itself as a resolute activity, directed towards the creation of immediate threats to the opponent, to the constraint of his position, to the restriction of the mobility of his forces s and his possibilities in general.
zh: 我们已经在本书中多次使用了术语“主动权”。拉丁词“initium”1 的意思是主动权的原理。生活中的主动权 - 这是人类工作任何领域活动的展示。主动权是在个人或集体思想的坚定努力中诞生、变得明显并发展起来的。在国际象棋斗争中，主动权同样表现为一种坚决的活动，旨在对对手产生直接威胁，限制他的位置，限制他的力量的机动性和总体可能性。

text: More often than not in the chess game, one of the opponents holds the initiative, but there will be occasions when the initiative runs across a counter-initiative, particularly when attacks are conducted on opposite flanks. The initiative will quite often bear a temporary character: it either runs dry or is intercepted by the opposing side.
zh: 在国际象棋对局中，对手之一经常持有主动权，但有时主动权会碰到对手主动权，特别是在对侧进行攻击时。主动权通常会具有先手的稀有特征：它要么耗尽，要么被对方拦截。

text: From the point of view of scale, manifestation of the initiative can be divided into several categories. The initiative can be small, firm, durable, dangerous, s strong etc. Sometimes it is said that the initiative develops into an attack. This is an inaccuracy. An attack represents an offensive. The initiative likewise often attends threats and offensives. But if an attack is always an initiative, then an initiative cannot in all cases be identified with an attack. For example, in the game Alekhine- Yates, White held the initiative for 40 moves - the whole process of manoeuvring - but he only obtained an attack at the end of the game, after the move g5, when he began an assault on the f6 and h7 pawns and created mating threats. Therefore to say that the initiative turns into an attack is roughly the same as talking about the change of boldness into bravery, cowardice into timidity, a laugh into a roar, etc.
zh: 从规模上来看，主动权的表现形式可以分为几类。主动权可以是小、坚固、耐用、危险、强大等。有时据说主动权发展成一种攻击。这是不准确的。攻击就代表进攻。主动权同样经常参与威胁和攻击。但如果攻击始终是主动权，则主动权无法在所有情况下都被识别为攻击。例如，在阿廖欣-耶茨对局中，白方持有主动权40步——调动的整个过程——但他只在对局结束时获得一次攻击，在g5步之后，当他开始攻击f6和h7时兵并创建了将杀威胁。所以说主动权变成攻击，大致相当于说大胆变成勇敢，怯懦变成胆怯，笑变成吼等等。

text: In the opening of the game, White holds a small initiative thanks to the right of the first move (let us say, after 1. d4, Black is deprived of the reply 1... e5). If Black succeeds in neutralising even such a slight initiative in the opening, then it is customary to consider that he has equalised the game, though, in the present case, the term "equalisation" bears a particularly conditional character.
zh: 在对局的开局中，由于第一步的权利，白方持有一个小主动权（比方说，在1. d4之后，黑方被剥夺了回复1... e5）。如果黑方在开局中成功地抵消了哪怕如此轻微的主动权，那么通常会认为他已经扳平了对局，尽管在目前的情况下，“扳平”一词带有特别的条件特征。

text: It happens that an opening develops symmetrically. ． This is observed sometimes in the Four Knights Opening, in the exchange variation of the French Defence, in the Italian Game and even in the Queen's Gambit. More often than not, White succeeds in obtaining a small initiative in symmetrical systems, once again thanks to having the first move.
zh: 碰巧开口是对称形成的。．有时会在四马开局、法兰西防御的兑换变例、意大利对局甚至后翼弃兵中观察到这种情况。通常情况下，白方会在对称系统中成功获得小主动权，这再次归功于先手棋。

text: Seizing the initiative is a definite creative achievement. The extent of this advantage depends on the character and strength of the initiative.
zh: 抓住主动权绝对是一项创造性成就。这种优势的程度取决于主动权的性格和强度。

text: Without mentioning the purely chess advantages of holding the initiative, one can boldly maintain that it evokes creative enthusiasm, stimulates an increase in work-rate of thought and imagination, promotes confidence in one's own strength. On the other hand, the need to parry the opponent's initiative quite often has a disastrous psychological influence, having a negative effect on the quality of play, on thes steadfastness of defence, and at times leads to demoralisation. It is no coincidence that a sizeable proportion of mistakes and oversights fall to the lot of chessplayers who come under the influence of the opponent's initiative in a game.
zh: 且不说持有主动权纯粹的国际象棋优势，我们可以大胆地认为它能唤起创造热情，激发思维和想象力工作效率的提高，增强对自身实力的信心。另一方面，招架对手主动权的需要常常会产生灾难性的心理影响，对对局质量、防守稳定性产生负面影响，有时还会导致士气低落。相当大比例的错误和疏忽都是由在对局中受到对手主动权影响的棋手造成的，这并非巧合。

text: The following two games might serve as a good illustration of this statement.
zh: 下面的两场对局或许可以很好地说明这一点。

zh: 玩得大胆又有趣。诚然，博列斯拉夫斯基自己指出“这是一个冒险的举动！白方本质上削弱了 e4 格，黑方从此在吃掉它的基础上构建了他的棋局。更小心的是 13. f3，避免了主动权的争夺，但保持了稳固的位置。”然而，在争夺主动权的斗争中，有时值得冒险，特别是如果考虑到拒绝这样的斗争不仅代表着棋局的投降，而且代表着一种心理立场的投降。

text: An interesting game in which the role of the initiative was expressed very boldly. For the first ten moves, White held quite firmly a small opening initiative. It waned after 12. e3, and finally ran dry after 16. Be2. From this moment Black directed the struggle towards a capture of the initiative. text: Black's initiative increased to a "crescendo" and quickly reached the force of a decisive attack, which already after eight moves achieved its objective. Mention should be made of the exceptional harmony yin the final attacking operation of all Black's pieces.

text: The initiative - this is a symbol of creative life in chess. The initiative - is an enemy of passivity and inactivity, waiting manoeuvring and complacent contemplation. This is why, in each period of the chess struggle, defending Or attacking, parrying or delivering blows, in moments of difficult trials and triumphant ideas, we ought to remember that the unfailing slogan, always and everywhere accompanying our inspired and creative thoughts, must be the slogan: "The desire for the initiative!".
zh: 主动权 - 这是国际象棋中创造性生活的象征。主动权 - 是被动和不活动、等待调动和自满沉思的敌人。这就是为什么，在国际象棋斗争的每一个时期，无论是防守还是进攻，是招架还是打击，在艰难的考验和胜利的思想时刻，我们都应该记住，始终随处伴随着我们的灵感和创造性思维的永恒口号一定是：“对主动权的渴望！”。
